snippet.title: AstroScaper - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
AstroScaper is a relaxing sci-fi puzzle city-builder where every building placement is a puzzle. Build across procedurally generated asteroids, discover powerful building synergies, optimize your colony, and play at your own pace.

Steam ‣ https://store.steampowered.com/app/3579350?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=gameplay_trailer&utm_content=description_link
Discord ‣ https://discord.gg/PSp4rgqRm6

🎵 Music:
Progression by Farid Saryev
https://linktr.ee/fsaryev

#astroscaper #indiegame #citybuilder
